about: Register a company with the Department of Health to offer health services through a mobile app.
note: Requirements read from the official Department of Health Abu Dhabi page on the checked date. The request is sent by email, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

timing: Reviewed by the Facility Licensing division, then approved by the information security team, then listed on the DOH website
channels: Email the request with the documents to hfld@doh.gov.ae
